title: submission.json
description: One student's answer to one exercise: which questions have a typed answer, which have pages, and whether it has been submitted. The answers themselves are `parts/<q>/answer.html` and `parts/<q>/pages/<n>.jpg`; the review of it is `review.json` and is never a student's to write.

exercise.description: the exercise this answers; the server writes it from the path

student.description: the student's generated `sid`, resolved by the gate from the caller's own access record — never from a request parameter, and never an email

state.description: `draft` while the student is working; `submitted` once they have handed it in. A second submit before the due date replaces the first

submittedAt.description: when it was last submitted; null while it is a draft

late.description: was the submission taken after `release.due`; the route computes it and the lecturer sees it on the row

parts.description: one entry per question that has anything in it, keyed by the question's id (the `data-id` of its section in questions.html)

updated.description: the last write of any kind

submissionPage.description: one uploaded page: its place in the question, where its bytes are, and how big it is

n.description: the page's place in this question, from 1

key.description: the store key the bytes are under; written by the route, never by a client

w.description: pixel width after the browser downscaled it

h.description: pixel height after the browser downscaled it

bytes.description: the size of the stored image

submissionPart.description: one question's answer: a typed fragment beside it, and the uploaded pages

typed.description: is there a `parts/<q>/answer.html` with something in it

pages.description: the uploaded pages in the order the student put them, at most 20
